bullets.text: C5 shows a Start button when it's offline or reconnecting.
C5 now shows a fresh alert when a new update is found.
Starting C5 is more reliable and shows a spinner.
Analytics - Autonomy tab shows live data enhacements.
Analytics - Agents tab gets 2 more telemetry charts.
Analytics - Tools activity charts reflect realtime usage.
Tasks - a crash must not spend a fairness turn.
Backups - GitHub connects when token is set in config.
Backups - adds override toggle to allow you to backup secret files.
Backups - auto-backups will pause if your GitHub account disconnects.
C5 now recovers a stuck gateway on Windows, and says what happened.
Tasks no longer wait indefinitely for their turn to start.
You can now restart or quit C5 straight from the side menu.
When C5 is off, the buttons tell you how to start it again.
A slow shutdown no longer looks like a crash or stops partway.
